text:
maria: Heads up — reproducing perf regression on longctx workloads. Memory keeps climbing ~1.2GB per minute after ~1500 tokens.

maria: KV cache occupancy keeps growing, fragmentation goes up, and then cont-batcher merge causes HOL blocking.

jon: can you paste pprof/counters?

maria: metrics snapshot:
```
kv_cache_total_bytes: 18432000000
kv_resident_bytes: 17400000000
kv_frag_pct: 14.3
kv_evictions_per_min: 0.2
contbatch_merge_rate: 230/s
hol_waits: 4500/s
avg_latency_p95: 210ms
```

liam: interesting — evictions low but frag high. suggests we aren't reclaiming small fragments due to head slot pinning.

sara: did we recently change batch coalescer thresholds?

maria: Yes, last week we increased merge window from 8->12ms to favor coalescing. My hypothesis: longer merge window lets batches pile up, they merge and pin long ctx kv slots across combined sequence length causing larger fragments and delayed reclamation.

jon: can you share flamegraph + alloc traces?

maria: attached flame link: https://internal/redwood/flame/2758234567 and small snippet:
```
alloc_heatmap: kv_slot_acquire 42% -> kv_slot_release 3% -> contbatch_merge 18%
```

liam: i ran a repro with perf counters — see gist: https://gist.github.com/example shows that slot_release is deferred until batch_commit which is delayed by HOL due to older head sequence waiting on upstream I/O.

sara: Quick experiment — change merge window down to 6ms and reduce max_merged_seq_len to 1024. Any chance to test on canary?

maria: spinning canary now with dyncfg: {merge_window_ms:6, max_merged_seq:1024, aggressive_eviction:true} — will post results in 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary started: infra/canary/kv-longctx-2758234567 @maria

maria: (10m later) Results: memory slope reduced to ~0.12GB/min, frag_pct stabilized ~3.2, hol_waits down to 210/s, p95 latency improved to 165ms.

jon: great. But throughput dropped 6% in peak — maybe more splits increases per-request compute.

liam: tradeoff acceptable for longctx customers. Could we make merge heuristics adaptive? e.g., if kv_frag_pct > 8% then backoff merging.

sara: also add quick path to force slab compaction on low activity (500ms idle) to reclaim small fragments.

maria: created PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8243 — adds adaptive_merge and idle_compact. Will run extended soak.

perfbot: perf regression alert suppressed for canary run 2758234567 due to bench context.

jon: once PR lands, add a test harness that replays longctx sequences with mix of small/large batches to confirm no regressions.

sara: also add metric for 'kv_slot_pin_duration' to track pinned time distribution — otherwise we only see hol_wait counts.

maria: ack. I'll add metric and correlate with batch merge events. Thanks team :thumbsup:
